articles.summary: Auna reports 10% FX-Neutral Revenue Growth and Continued Strong Cash Generation in 3Q2026; Mexico Returns to Year-over-Year Adjusted EBITDA Growth; Profitability Pressured by Specific Headwinds in Colombia and Peru Leverage Improves to 3.5x Auna (NYSE: AUNA) (“Auna” or the “Company”), a leading healthcare platform in Latin America with operations in Mexico, Peru, and Colombia, announced today unaudited financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 (“Third quarter 2026” or “3Q26”). Financial results are expressed in Peruvian Soles (“S/” or “PEN” or “Soles”) and are presented in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (“IFRS”), unless otherwise noted. 3Q’26 Consolidated Highlights Revenue increased 10% YoY FXN and 19% YoY as reported to S/1,325 million, with sequential growth of 3% FXN and 7% as reported Adjusted EBITDA was S/231 million, decreasing 4.6% FXN while remaining flat as reported.
